title: The classification of non-solvable transitive BLT-sets of $\mathcal{Q}(4,q)$
summary: For an odd prime power $q$, a BLT-set $\mathcal B$ is a set of $(q+1)$ points of $\mathcal Q(4,q)$ such that every point of $\mathcal Q(4,q)$ is collinear with at most two points of $\mathcal B$. We complete the classification of BLT-sets of $\mathcal Q(4,q)$ admitting a non-solvable transitive automorphism group. Nelson and Penttila completed the classification of BLT-sets $\mathcal B$ with a non-solvable transitive automorphism group acting irreducibly on the underlying $5$-dimensional vector space.
